clue.text: Spirits prior to Conservative account limited by definition

indicators.note: prior to places the spirits piece ahead of the party piece in the answer

parts.note: shorts are measures of spirits such as whisky or gin, served in small glasses
a Tory is a member of the UK Conservative Party

explanation.surface: A bookkeeper sneers at a Tory's limited account after a round of whiskies.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is a cryptic one: a tale whose brevity is built into its very name.
explanation.definitionFit: A brief work of prose fiction is, by its name, a narrative whose length is restricted.

clue.text: There's no good in rapid rise, certainly in the USA

parts.note: a surge is a sudden powerful upward rush

explanation.surface: A sudden spike in prices, without anything good about it, as Americans would certainly say.
explanation.definitionFit: Americans use this word as an adverb meaning certainly, as in a cheerful yes of agreement.

clue.text: Gold trades can be trying experiences

parts.note: or is the heraldic term for gold
deals are trades or business transactions

explanation.surface: Dealing in gold on the markets can be a stressful business.

explanation.definitionFit: Severe tests of endurance or painful episodes are trying experiences, a straight synonym.

clue.text: New RAF charter transformed combat in the field

indicators.note: transformed says the letters of the three words are changed into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A fresh air force charter changed how battles are fought on the ground.
explanation.definitionFit: Fighting from dug-out lines facing the enemy, as on the Western Front, is a form of battlefield combat.

clue.text: Excited, went to bed with love for one

clue.text: Rights protecting expert runner

clue.text: Taken advantage of by American and heartlessly evicted

explanation.definitionFit: Exploited, manipulated for someone else's benefit: a common synonym.

clue.text: Top moves in close field event

parts.note: to close is to shut

indicators.note: moves says the letters of top shift into a new order

explanation.surface: Top-level changes in a closed meeting.
explanation.definitionFit: Throwing the heavy metal ball is an athletics discipline held on the field rather than the track.

clue.text: Take hope from a resident shuffling around hospital

indicators.note: around says the rearranged letters sit round the hospital letter
shuffling means the letters of a resident are mixed up

explanation.surface: A dispiriting sight: a resident shuffling around a hospital ward.
explanation.definitionFit: To discourage or demoralise someone is to take away their confidence and spirits.

clue.text: Looking embarrassed — expensive-sounding for a stag?

parts.note: dear means costly, expensive

diction is a manner of speaking or enunciating

clue.text: Got up before court date to get material for carpenter

explanation.definitionFit: A dark fragrant tropical hardwood used for fine furniture is timber for a carpenter.

clue.text: Hole caused by credit taking in charge

clue.text: Rant making one earn a hug, possibly?

clue.text: Frogman with time to entertain

clue.text: Geographical features of very narrow streets

clue.text: Not very good — book covered in beer after amorous advance

clue.text: Extreme letters supporting ban on working for instant prosperity

clue.text: Alliance taking company line prior to Labour speech

clue.text: The heart, for example, of a music producer

an instrument of pipes and keys that produces music, as in a church

clue.text: Habitual attire even when running
